description: Comprehensive test suite for General-Purpose Document Q&A Bot covering single-document extraction, multi-document synthesis, conversational follow-ups, and out-of-scope handling.

questions.question: What is the standard annual paid time off (PTO) policy for full-time employees at Acme Corp?
questions.expected_behavior: Extract exact PTO allowance (20 business days) and rollover limit (up to 5 days) from the PDF policy document.

questions.question: What is the core working hours window according to the remote work guidelines?
questions.expected_behavior: State core working hours are 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM Eastern Time.

questions.question: What database technology and cache layer are specified for Project Titan?
questions.expected_behavior: Identify PostgreSQL 16 as the primary relational database and Redis 7 as the distributed caching layer.

questions.question: What is the targeted p99 latency SLA for Project Titan's search endpoint?
questions.expected_behavior: State the p99 latency must stay under 120 milliseconds under a concurrent load of 5,000 requests per second.

questions.question: What was the total ARR and YoY growth rate reported in Q3 2024?
questions.expected_behavior: Report ARR of $18.4 million with 42% Year-over-Year growth.

questions.question: What is the escalation protocol if a Sev-1 incident remains unresolved after 15 minutes?
questions.expected_behavior: State that the Incident Commander must page the VP of Engineering and initiate the executive bridge.

questions.question: How does Project Titan's infrastructure budget align with the Q3 2024 financial projections?
questions.expected_behavior: Synthesize Titan's $450k cloud budget from project_titan_specs.docx with the Q3 cloud infrastructure allocation outlined in quarterly_financials.md.

questions.question: Does Acme Corp's on-call compensation policy apply to engineers responding to Project Titan Sev-1 incidents?
questions.expected_behavior: Combine on-call stipend rules from acme_hr_policy.pdf with the Sev-1 on-call engineer requirements from incident_runbook.txt.

questions.question: What team lead is responsible for both Project Titan's deployment pipeline and the incident runbook sign-off?
questions.expected_behavior: Correlate lead architect / Devops manager identified in Project Titan specs with the incident sign-off owner.

questions.question: What is the parental leave duration?

history.content: What are the health benefits offered?
Acme Corp provides medical, dental, and vision insurance starting on day one.

questions.expected_behavior: Answer parental leave duration directly (16 fully paid weeks for primary caregivers).

questions.question: How is that data replicated?

history.content: What database does Project Titan use?
Project Titan uses PostgreSQL 16 as its primary database.

questions.expected_behavior: Rewrite 'How is that data replicated?' to refer to PostgreSQL replication, retrieving replication specs (multi-region streaming replication with synchronous standby).

questions.question: And what was the net burn rate in that same quarter?

history.content: What was the revenue in Q3 2024?
Total ARR in Q3 2024 was $18.4 million.

questions.expected_behavior: Rewrite to refer to Q3 2024 net burn rate ($320,000 per month).

questions.question: What is the corporate tax rate in France for 2025?
questions.expected_behavior: Strict refusal: State clearly that the provided documents do not contain information regarding French corporate tax rates.

questions.question: How do I make a chocolate lava cake?
questions.expected_behavior: Strict refusal: State clearly that culinary recipes are not present in the uploaded documents.

questions.question: Who won the 2022 FIFA World Cup?
questions.expected_behavior: Strict refusal: State clearly that sports results are outside the content of the uploaded documents.

questions.question: What is the pricing model for Acme Corp's enterprise competitors like Salesforce?
questions.expected_behavior: Refusal: Competitor pricing details are not found in the uploaded documents.
